description: Master cross-case index. The per-case digests in summaries/json/ are the leaves; this file is the spine. It is keyed by Supply Code provision so that, across all ~300 judgments, one can read how each clause of a State Electricity Supply Code has been construed, and by legal principle for the cross-cutting doctrines. Built incrementally from each case's supply_code block. Nothing here is authored by hand for the bulk run — it is generated by tools/build_supply_code.py (to be adapted from tools/build_merged.py).

UP-2005::4.26(e).topic: Parallel operating charges under pre-existing agreements

cases.title: Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. v. State of U.P. & 3 Others
cases.holding: 4.26(e) preserves parallel-operating charges only till termination of the agreement; it cannot be invoked to bill indefinitely for a facility the licensee has itself disconnected, where the delay in terminating/amending is attributable to the licensee.

UP-2005::56(2).topic: Limitation on recovery of arrears (pleaded; conflated with s.56(2) of the Act)

cases.title: Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. v. State of U.P. & 3 Others
cases.holding: 'Sum due' requires an adjudicated amount; escalating un-adjudicated demands raised long after the service ended are barred.

no-advantage-of-own-wrong.label: No one may take advantage of his own wrong (commodum ex injuria sua nemo habere debet)

cases.application: Applied to a State distribution licensee: 7 years to disconnect and 10 more to amend the agreement, the delay being solely attributable to the licensee, which therefore could not bill for the intervening period.

acquiescence-cuts-both-ways.label: Acquiescence bars both the consumer's refund and the licensee's silent-billing recovery

cases.application: Bars the consumer's refund of pre-2008 charges paid without demur; equally bars the licensee that only raised bills and never took statutory recourse to recover.
